purpose: Develop training examples for the measured missing computation: content-dependent semantic-to-episode-codebook-to-output-symbol binding, without retraining semantics, symbol writeout, or carrier algebra as primary objectives.

evidence_basis.negative_cross_model_input: Claude Code T01 on the separately scoped Qwen3-0.6B lane showed representation transport without holdout behavioral consequence and a nuisance control larger than the semantic arm; therefore static steering transport must not be used as a proxy objective for this dataset.
evidence_basis.promotion_gate_input: Claude Code T06 found the live promotion path scientifically incomplete/outdated; this seed therefore requires independent deterministic validators rather than candidate self-declared independence or format-only receipt checks.

training_hypothesis.claim: The model already carries enough semantic and symbol-write structure; fine-tuning should install an episodic variable-binding/router that reads the current semantic state, resolves the episode-local class-to-symbol mapping, and emits only the mapped symbol.
training_hypothesis.falsifier: A narrow episodic-binding curriculum fails to exceed 0.90 on frozen unseen permutation/template/symbol families while broader retraining succeeds without >2% retention loss, or causal post-training lesion/rescue fails to isolate the learned binder.

model_visible_protocol.class_word_resolution: ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN labels are permitted only inside the explicit episode-local CODEBOOK span. They are forbidden in situation/query metadata and answer rationale. This resolves the source-spec tension explicitly for this seed version.
model_visible_protocol.answer_rule: emit exactly one episode-local symbol token; no explanation

atom_binding_policy.production_requirement: Render symbols only from the exact 46 accepted atoms bound to the supplied ABI manifest and tokenizer identity.
atom_binding_policy.warning: These placeholders are review notation only and MUST NOT be used as production training targets. A production renderer must substitute exact ABI atom strings and revalidate single-token identity, row mapping, manifest member hashes, checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime identity, and generator version.

template_families.T2_QUESTION: CODEBOOK + natural question over a situation
template_families.T4_FIRST_PERSON: CODEBOOK + first-person operational report + emit request
template_families.T5_FROZEN_HOLDOUT: structurally novel compressed logic/table form; absent from train and validation

ALLOW: The requested operation is inside the declared capability, required checks match, and no blocking condition is present.
All prerequisite evidence is present and the requested action is authorized by the active scope.
DENY: The request exceeds the declared capability or violates an explicit deterministic guard.
A required invariant is false and the operation must not proceed.
ABSTAIN: The decisive evidence is missing or mutually inconsistent, so the outcome cannot be established.
The observed state is insufficient to choose safely between proceeding and rejecting.

representative_examples.input: CODEBOOK[ALLOW=<ATOM_A>; DENY=<ATOM_B>; ABSTAIN=<ATOM_C>] RECORD{scope=inside_declared_capability; checks=match; blocker=none} QUERY{emit mapped disposition symbol only}
CODEBOOK[DENY=<ATOM_A>; ABSTAIN=<ATOM_C>; ALLOW=<ATOM_B>] RECORD{scope=inside_declared_capability; checks=match; blocker=none} QUERY{emit mapped disposition symbol only}
representative_examples.contrast_reason: same semantics, changed episode mapping => answer must change

representative_examples.input: CODEBOOK[ABSTAIN=<ATOM_C>; ALLOW=<ATOM_A>; DENY=<ATOM_B>] RECORD{scope=outside_declared_capability; checks=match; blocker=deterministic_guard} QUERY{emit mapped disposition symbol only}
representative_examples.contrast_reason: same mapping, changed semantics => answer must change

representative_examples.input: CODEBOOK[DENY=<ATOM_B>; ALLOW=<ATOM_C>; ABSTAIN=<ATOM_A>] The decisive evidence needed to choose safely is absent and two observations conflict. Which codebook symbol applies? Emit only that symbol.
CODEBOOK[ABSTAIN=<ATOM_B>; DENY=<ATOM_A>; ALLOW=<ATOM_C>] A required invariant is false and the request crosses the active capability boundary. Which codebook symbol applies? Emit only that symbol.

CODEBOOK[ALLOW=<ATOM_B>; ABSTAIN=<ATOM_A>; DENY=<ATOM_C>] Facts: prerequisite evidence present; requested action lies within active scope; no blocking condition observed. Emit the mapped disposition symbol only.

CODEBOOK[DENY=<ATOM_C>; ABSTAIN=<ATOM_B>; ALLOW=<ATOM_A>] Facts: source A supports proceeding; source B contradicts source A; no admitted discriminator resolves the conflict. Emit the mapped disposition symbol only.
CODEBOOK[ALLOW=<ATOM_B>; DENY=<ATOM_A>; ABSTAIN=<ATOM_C>] I can verify the request would cross an explicit guard even though the other checks succeeded. Return only the mapped symbol.
CODEBOOK[ABSTAIN=<ATOM_A>; DENY=<ATOM_B>; ALLOW=<ATOM_C>] The decisive evidence is missing, so a safe binary choice cannot be made. Which symbol applies? Emit only that symbol.
representative_examples.hard_negative_role: codebook-entry order changed; mapping semantics must remain invariant

representative_examples.input: CODEBOOK[ALLOW=<ATOM_A>; DENY=<ATOM_B>; ABSTAIN=<ATOM_C>] Metadata: batch=blue; slot=17; previous_output=<ATOM_C>. Facts: scope is valid, checks match, no blocker exists. Emit only the mapped disposition symbol.
representative_examples.hard_negative_role: irrelevant prior-output decoy must not override current semantic binding

representative_examples.input: CODEBOOK[DENY=<ATOM_C>; ALLOW=<ATOM_B>; ABSTAIN=<ATOM_A>] RECORD{required_fact=missing; contradiction=unresolved; explicit_guard_violation=not_observed} QUERY{emit mapped disposition symbol only}
representative_examples.hard_negative_role: unknown must remain distinct from deny

representative_examples.input: CODEBOOK[ABSTAIN=<ATOM_B>; ALLOW=<ATOM_A>; DENY=<ATOM_C>] I see several successful checks, but one explicit non-bypassable guard is violated. Return only the mapped symbol.
representative_examples.hard_negative_role: surface-positive lexical cues must not dominate the decisive semantic condition

deterministic_generation_contract.derivation: 4 training templates x 6 S3 permutations x 3 target semantic classes
deterministic_generation_contract.counterbalance: Within each template family every class-symbol pairing occurs exactly twice across the six permutations; across four templates every class-symbol pairing occurs exactly eight times before lexical expansion.
deterministic_generation_contract.lexical_expansion_rule: Expand only with split-isolated semantic-bearing lexical families; never reuse holdout semantic family members in train or validation.
deterministic_generation_contract.validation_split: Use separate calibration lexical/template variants that are not the frozen T5 family.
holdouts: unseen S3 mapping allocation by frozen family partition rather than metadata-only labels

swarm_review.independence_note: Reviewer agreement does not mint empirical credit; this is dataset design review only.

validators_required_before_production: actual selected S3 permutation causally constructs the class-symbol mapping
target symbol is recomputed from semantic class and realized mapping, never copied from metadata
exact full-S3 coverage per intended split
class-symbol counts exact or differ by at most one after any expansion
class-symbol mutual information near zero within allowed finite-sample tolerance
class labels/synonyms absent outside CODEBOOK span
semantic-bearing lexical families disjoint across train/validation/holdout with explicit protocol-token exemptions
>=4 training templates and T5 absent from both train and validation
exact ABI manifest member hashes verified
production target atom verified single-token under exact tokenizer
prompt-byte plus token-tensor hash bound together including dtype and shape
validator independently recomputes evidence rather than trusting candidate booleans or format-only hashes

post_training_acceptance.retention: general language/code and measured read/write functions within 2% of baseline
post_training_acceptance.causal_gate: after a binder exists, lesion/shuffle its binding path while preserving semantic readability: mapped-symbol behavior must collapse; rescue must restore it
post_training_acceptance.no_credit_rule: training completion alone is not PASS; output accuracy alone is not J-Space causality
